material.acceptance_criteria: The load-1 mechanism is identified by direct network probe (request/response log for web_bg.wasm across 3 loads); the finding recorded in the row resolution or AGENTS.md if durable
material.description: Run 40536986555 logged web_bg.wasm at 1444974 B on load 1 vs 2408290 B on loads 2-3; the local rerun of the 40538066466 artifact logged 1445694 B on load 1 vs 963796 B on loads 2-3. Same build inside a run, first-draw.mjs caches gzip bodies and sends content-length, so per-load byte totals should be constant. Find the mechanism (partial read / request count / measurement timing) and name whether any real bytes are missing.

material.subject: first-draw load 1 records a different web_bg.wasm transfer than loads 2-3 of the same run
material.witness_plan: Separate-session witness re-parses the first-draw logs and runs the probe script, confirming the steady-state size and the load-1 deviation

note: Direct server-side probe (scripts artifact, 3 loads) shows the gzip wasm body is 481898 B and logged totals are integer multiples of it (963796=2x steady loads, 1445694=3x on load 1; run 40536986555's readings sit at the same multiples of its own per-request size). Mechanism: first-draw.mjs note() counts one full body per request, and the boot fetches the wasm more than once (bindgen glue; load 1 takes an extra request that the browser aborts, which the server still counts). No bytes are lost -- the compare job hashes Always match. The double fetch is filed as its own row (playjs-wasm-fetched-more-than-once-per-load). AGENTS.md corrected in 6605cf1bb8b80d932c702fe8b1b336497b2163d6.
